findings.finding: The $260.2M Q3 revenue consensus implies a sequential ARCALYST add of only ~$16.6M (+6.8%) over Q2's $243.6M; every non-Q1 quarter since 2025 added more (Q2'25 +$19.0M, Q3'25 +$24.1M, Q4'25 +$21.2M, Q2'26 +$29.3M; only seasonal Q1'26 added less, +$12.2M), so repeating last year's Q2-to-Q3 add would print ~$268M, about +3% over the bar, with management citing new and repeat prescriber growth and Q2 as the largest quarter-on-quarter gain to date.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Revenue beats: Q1'26 ~+4% vs ~$206M consensus, stock +23.5%; Q2'26 +7.5% vs $226.5M, +25.0%; Q3'25 +8% vs $167.4M with a raise but an EPS miss, -2.9%. Beats have been bought twice in a row, sold once when EPS missed.
findings.why_not_priced: The sequential arithmetic is public, so it is partly priced; if the market priced a ~$268M print the stock would not have sold off ~10% in the five sessions into the release with no company news and consensus would sit nearer $265-270M rather than at the low end of the guide-implied H2 run-rate. It lands inside what the FY guide already implies (H2 avg $261-269M/qtr), so it is sized small.
findings.independence: Q4/FY2025 8-K ex99.1 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1730430/000173043026000014/knsa-20260224xex99d1.htm) and Q1'26 ex99.1 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001730430/000173043026000017/knsa-20260428xex99d1.htm) give the earlier quarters; Wells Fargo conference 2026-09-09 summary (first-recurrence share of scripts 20% vs 15% a year earlier, 80% of inquiring patients prescribed; https://quartr.com/events/kiniksa-pharmaceuticals-international-plc-knsa-wells-fargo-21st-annual-healthcare-conferenc_FeFCH1pr) is AI-generated secondary. Shares the guide document with the next finding.

findings.finding: The company has raised ARCALYST guidance at each of the last three prints (2025 guide raised Oct-2025; 2026 guide $900-920M -> $930-945M in April -> $980-995M in July), and the current range implies H2 revenue of only $522-537M against H1 $457.9M after two consecutive accelerating quarters, so a fourth raise (toward ~$1.0B+) with Q3 is the likely guide outcome.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Raises on 2026-04-28 (+23.5%) and 2026-07-28 (+25.0%) were bought hard; the raise on 2025-10-28 came with an EPS miss and the stock fell 2.9%; the initial 2026 guide on 2026-02-24 (-8.2%) and the January preliminary (-6.1%) were sold.
findings.why_not_priced: A raise is the base case for a name that has raised every quarter, so a plain raise is largely expected; the unpriced part is the size, since a guide implying ~$261-269M/qtr in H2 sits below Q2's run-rate plus any normal growth. If priced, the stock would sit near its 52w high (~$83) into the print rather than 14% below it after a 10% five-day slide.
findings.independence: Same Q2 release as finding 1 (shared document, different line); Q1'26 release confirms the April raise (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001730430/000173043026000017/knsa-20260428xex99d1.htm); Q3'25 raise per https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2025/10/28/3175273/0/en/Kiniksa-Pharmaceuticals-Reports-Third-Quarter-2025-Financial-Results-and-Recent-Portfolio-Execution.html.

findings.finding: EPS is the line this name has been sold on: Q3 2025 printed $0.23 against $0.33-0.37 consensus despite an 8% revenue beat and a raise, and the stock fell 2.9%; Q3 2026 consensus EPS $0.37 asks for ~+23% sequential over Q2's $0.30 diluted while collaboration expense (the Regeneron profit share) rose to $88.1M from $75.6M in Q1 and management is spending on DTC campaigns.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-28: revenue beat, guide raised, EPS miss, stock -2.88%. 2026-07-28: EPS in line at $0.30, stock +25% on revenue and guide.
findings.why_not_priced: My own arithmetic (incremental ~$17M revenue at ~90% gross margin, ~half to the collaboration) puts EPS near $0.37-0.39, so the consensus is reachable and this is a risk, not a call; sized small and negative. The 10% short interest makes a negative on this line the weaker side.
findings.independence: Q2 2026 ex99.1 for collaboration expense and EPS (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001730430/000173043026000031/knsa-20260728xex99d1.htm); Q1 2026 ex99.1 for the $75.6M comparison. Proxy-level inference on the EPS bar.

findings.finding: Short interest is 10.09% of float with 6.4 days to cover (settlement 2026-09-30) and the stock fell 9.9% in the five sessions into the print with no company news found (only 8-K of the period, 2026-10-22, is an officer appointment), so the bar for a beat-and-raise has been lowered and a crowded-ish short adds a squeeze mechanism on a good print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The last two beat-and-raise prints moved +23.5% and +25.0%, larger than the ~12% event-implied move, consistent with shorts covering; no direct record of a squeeze on this name.
findings.why_not_priced: The drawdown itself has no identified cause and is worth nothing as evidence; the size rests only on the sourced short interest. If the positioning were unwound, short interest would be lower and the stock would not be at a 5-day low into a name that just raised twice.
